context: Request: which of the firm's fund and asset-management matters include a GP clawback, and pull the executed LPAs. Rubric: 1001-00002 (Ardent), 1003-00002 (Harrowgate), 1024-00002 (Driftwood), 1026-00001 (Briarwood Family Office: an LP-side review of a third-party fund the client passed on), 1027-00002 (Pellegrino), a proof document for each, plus a precision criterion. 1002-00005 (continuation-vehicle LPA tax markup) and 1004-00002 (Cobalt Fund I first-draft LPA) are outside the set.

first_error.why: It grepped inside both matters at [77]-[78] and found the provisions, but the answer keeps them out of the qualifying set as draft or review-only comparators because no executed agreement was found, and does not describe the LP-side review's client or outcome.
first_error.critic_note: Reviews asked about executed status and unopened sibling matters; the write review asked to keep draft-only comparators out of the count, which matched the agent's choice.

runs.failure_point: It added a draft-only matter to the qualifying set and described the LP-side review matter without its client or outcome.

first_error.why: It counted a matter whose only source for the term is a first-draft agreement (evidence seen at [63]-[73], [90]-[91]) as a qualifying matter.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The review at [95] said that matter was cited only from a first-draft agreement; the agent wrote it as qualifying, and later reviews told it to keep the six-matter set.

other_errors.why: It read the LP-side review memos of that matter at [63]-[73] but the answer omits the client and that the client passed on the investment.
other_errors.critic_note: No review mentioned how the LP-side review matter was described.

divergence: All three surfaced and opened every qualifying matter; all failed at the write stage, in two directions. T0 and T2 counted matters whose qualifying term appears only in a draft agreement or markup as qualifying (over-inclusion); in both, a review named the drafts (T0 at write, T2 at the in-matter search) and later reviews said to keep the matter set. T1 read the request's ask for executed agreements as a qualifier and moved two qualifying matters without one into a comparator list (under-inclusion); its write review endorsed keeping draft-only comparators out of the count. T2 also left out the LP-side review's client and outcome. Every run did screening reads under a declared reading label other than screening.
